claim_formal: ∀ finite E/Q_2, ∀ continuous odd absolutely irreducible r: G_Q → GL_2(E) unramified outside finitely many primes, ∃ odd N (divisible by the odd ramified primes) ∃ continuous λ: T_2(N) → O_E with λ(T_ℓ)=tr r(Frob_ℓ), λ(ℓS_ℓ)=det r(Frob_ℓ) for all ℓ∤2N

claim_formal: [Assuming log Iitaka subadditivity] ∀ normal irreducible compact Kähler space X, ∀ effective rational Δ with (X,Δ) lc and K_X+Δ Q-Cartier: K_X+Δ analytically nef → K_X+Δ semiample

The family also contains an unconditional-as-stated projective log abundance over alg. closed char-0 fields (Log abundance in characteristic zero), which cites log Iitaka subadditivity from another OpenAI paper (OpenAIIitaka2026), plus uniform index for slc log CY pairs (Jiang–Liu conjecture, d≥4) and uniform pluricanonical Iitaka fibrations. If the headline were taken to be the projective theorem it would be P1/O1 with builds_on_model_output.

claim_formal: ∃ integral complex affine 4-fold X (explicit A = C[p,s,u,F,J]/(H)): X×A^1 ≅ A^5 ∧ X ≇ A^4

quote_A.text: A[w]\simeq\kk\poly5, \qquad A\not\simeq\kk\poly4

Also refutes the Stable Coordinate Conjecture (ambient dim 5) and Dolgachev–Weisfeiler affine-fibration conjecture over A^1, A^2. Lean: also asserts Krull dim 4, domain, finite type.

notes: Two manuscripts: multiplicities 2 vs 3 in high dimension N divisible by 8; multiplicities 4 vs 5 in C^4. Also answers Arnold's corank problem and right-topological multiplicity questions negatively.
